summary: Cyber App Solutions Corp. filed an 8-K reporting an agreement with secured creditors Kips Bay Select LP and Cyber One, Ltd. to adjourn a foreclosure sale from July 7, 2026 to August 4, 2026. The company is evaluating strategic alternatives and in discussions regarding its outstanding indebtedness. No specific terms, price, or premium are disclosed. The filing indicates a distressed situation with potential restructuring or resolution of debt. Monitor for any transaction or creditor agreement that may emerge, with risk-arb focusing on the outcome of the foreclosure deferral.
